description: This file defines the SugarLoggerHandler class, which integrates Monolog logging with the LoggerManager in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for writing log records and converting log levels.

classes.name: SugarLoggerHandler
classes.description: A class that extends Monolog's AbstractProcessingHandler to route logs through SuiteCRM's LoggerManager, converting PSR log levels to SuiteCRM log levels.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Handles writing a log record to the SuiteCRM logger, converting the log level and formatting the message.

methods.name: psrToSugarLevel
methods.description: Converts Monolog PSR log levels to SuiteCRM-specific log level strings.
